convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for TSI_MACD indicator which is a custom indicator, plus external .mqh libraries (TradeAlgorithms.mqh, SmoothAlgorithms.mqh) for trade execution and smoothing algorithms that would need manual reimplementation in Python

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars needed for indicator calculation
TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime for position open timing

other_exits: Opposite signal triggers close of existing position via BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose with BuyPosClose/SellPosClose input gates

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum determines sizing: LOT=fixed lot size (0.1), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss; MM input (0.1) interpreted as either lot size or percentage fraction depending on MMMode

custom_logic_notes: Entry crossover uses bars [1] vs [0] from SignalBar offset: Ind[1]>Sign[1] (previous bar confirming direction) AND Ind[0]<=Sign[0] (current bar showing the cross happened). SignalBar=1 means signals are evaluated on the previous completed bar. The EA uses a Recount flag that forces recalculation if CopyBuffer fails. UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime are passed to BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen functions from TradeAlgorithms.mqh for trade timing. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose are boolean inputs that independently gate each trade action.
python_conversion_notes: The TSI_MACD custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python - it combines True Strength Index logic with MACD-style signal line, using configurable smoothing methods (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA beyond standard EMA/SMA). The SmoothAlgorithms.mqh library provides GetStartBars() and the smoothing implementations. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose with margin mode logic - these must be replaced with direct order placement via broker API. The MarginMode enum controls 5 different position sizing methods that all need implementation. The crossover detection uses buffer[1]>buffer[1] for direction and buffer[0]<=buffer[0] for the actual cross event, evaluated on SignalBar=1 (previous completed bar).
